summary: A row of connected buttons where only one can be selected at a time, like a toggle switch group.
description: A segmented control that groups moz-segmented-control-item children and lets a user switch between them, functioning as either a tab switcher (when wired to a named-deck via the deck attribute) or a radio button group. Extends the shared SelectControlBaseElement, so it also inherits label, description, name, and orientation handling from that base class even though this subclass's own JSDoc only documents deck/value/name/disabled.

attributes.name: deck
attributes.description: Optional ID of a named-deck to control for tab switching.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The control's items, intended for moz-segmented-control-item children.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles up from a selected child item; the control updates its value and (if deck is set) switches the linked named-deck's view.
